lines.en: Apparently, night has come. And apparently, I am once again naked in the presence of a girl who would much prefer me to not be naked probably ever.
Yet, she is the one who crafted this occasion- albeit with a fervor drastically unlike that with which she crafts everything else. She’s like a contractor, though.
The type you pay to come over and figure out how to improve your living situation because you couldn’t ever be bothered to figure things out on your own.
Maybe you were just busy. Maybe you didn’t have the time. Or maybe you were repeatedly molested at a young age as well and are now permanently emotionally stunted as a result of that.
Whatever the case, it’s probably fine to lean on others to compensate for things you lack. But when the person you’re leaning on is lacking as well, it starts to feel like everything is hopeless.
Or perhaps “pointless” would be a better way to describe it?
We don’t have to be here. Io doesn’t have to be crawling outside of her box just to peek inside of mine. But I’m the cat in this scenario, and she thinks she has adopted me.
So, for the experiment’s sake, let’s say there’s a world where this didn’t happen. Where I kept my clothes on and went home.
Would the Io in that world be happier than the one here? Would I be happier as well?
And, if we exist in both of these places at once, which outcome would a computer select if you commanded it to choose the “better” route?
Anyway, it’s not like this matters. Keeping any sort of cat in any kind of box is a form of animal cruelty.
But, in thinking that, I realize just how much of a sinner I am.
And that being this way will keep it harder for any inner-monologue to stave off the inevitable erection I am going to get being around Io like this.

: So does talking about this...not bother you anymore? Because you kept it hidden for a while, Io. And I can’t say the reveal was all that nice.

: Kind of makes sense in hindsight why I took to you so quickly with that in mind. I feel less weird about my attachment issues now.
: Uta’s situation is horrible for sure...but it’s a lot different than ours. Did talking to her really help?
: Not in the sense that it helped me accept who I am. But in the sense of having somebody to connect with who didn’t just want to hurt me, yeah.
: Have you adequately convinced yourself I don’t want to hurt you either then?
: First yes, then no. Now, I’m leaning back toward yes since I’ve recovered from the sex scene. You were super creepy that night, Sensei.
: Yeah...that happens sometimes. But I won’t burden you with yet another apology since you’ll just spin it into you not deserving one.
: Where’d that come from anyway? It was like a switch flipped and you were suddenly a textbook grown-up.
: That’s not what “grown-ups” are like, Io.
: The ones I know are. And it’s going to be hard to argue the opposite since you did the same exact thing after luring me into thinking you were one of the good ones.
: Okay. Maybe I will apologize again, then.
: Seriously, it’s fine. I blew up and you just...went into damage control. But now we know we cope differently and it won’t happen again. Right?
: Right...
: So being in this situation right now, then...how do you feel?
: Do you need a few minutes to come up with an answer that won’t make you sound scary?
: More like a few years. Ask me again then.
: You’re enjoying it then? It doesn’t feel counterintuitive being washed by someone so naturally unclean?
: I’m enjoying it, sure. And it doesn’t feel counterintuitive. But it still feels like I’m unintentionally forcing you to do this since I know you don’t want to.
: I don’t mind things like this at all, Sensei. Being close physically when I can’t have sex makes stuff that probably seems normal for you actually really intimate for me.

: Io, come on...it’s not okay to talk about yourself like that either.

: Maybe on paper, sure. But, as a sex-averse teenage girl, isn’t it kind of on me for putting all of my eggs in a basket belonging to a guy who just goes around and has sex with teenage girls every day?

: Why not come down to my age for a little while instead, Sensei? Give yourself a break from feeling sorry for yourself. Not like that’s ever helped me, but still.
: I don’t think you’d like me if I was your age.
: Likewise. There’s no way you’d choose me out of a crowd if we went to school together. You only did because I practically threw myself at you.
: You’re pretty terrible at this whole back-washing thing if this is supposed to be relaxing. It’s just been nonstop sadness ever since I took my pants off.

: Okay. That’s enough of this. I’m getting out of-
: Hold on. We’re not done yet, mister.
: Io...what are you doing?
: Just a little special service. No charge, of course. Other than your continued attention, that is. Which is more than enough to have earned this, so-
: I’ve already stopped you from doing this once and now you’re doing it again? I already told you, you don’t have to give me anything in exchange for my attention, Io. You can just have it.
: Are you going to stop me today too? It’s really hard. How does that feel, by the way? Like, just being hard. Not my hand.

: Stop because you don’t like it? Or because I don’t like it? Who are you doing this for?

: How about you just shut up and let me make my own decision this time since you chose for me in my bedroom? That seems only fair, right?

: A couple reasons, really. One — I never learn. And I have an affinity for pulling triggers just to see what it sounds like when the gun goes off.
: Two — I don’t like feeling like a burden. And I know you’re going to say I’m not, but the fact remains that this is something you want that I have the ability to give.

: And four — I just feel bad making you wait until you get home to take care of yourself. It’ll put my mind at ease knowing you’re not holding back when you’re around me.
: All pretty logical reasons, don’t you think?
: I don’t think logic should be a factor here at all if what you’re doing makes you sick to your stomach.
: Do I look sick right now? Do I sound sick?
: No, but-
: Because I’m not sick. And again, this much is fine. You’re making it sound like I’m anti-arousal entirely and that’s just not true, Sensei.
: Wait, it’s not? But I...I thought...
: Thought what? That I’m just completely oblivious to pleasure as a whole? That I live in a bubble of permanent abstinence, forever ignorant of what a body needs to function?
: Kind of, yeah...
: Do you think I don’t masturbate either then?
: I mean...do you?...
: Uh-huh. Not very often probably, given that my sex-drive burnt out after being pushed beyond its limits for too long. But I still do it every now and then.
: You’re cute. I can feel it trying to twitch.

: I think I should be the one asking you that. I feel kind of bad just using my hand when everybody else is able to give you more.

: Then I’d say you’re wrong since “mental fortitude” and I don’t really mix. So do us both a favor and try to see this as a little more than just physical bonding.
: I feel like...you should get some enjoyment out of physical bonding too...
: My enjoyment comes from watching you react. That’s more than enough for me, Sensei. And it’s not like you can kiss me from that angle, so...

: I’m not sure. Past occurrences make it harder for me to confidently say you won’t try to penetrate me if I come any closer. I’m just not sure if I can trust you.
: Yeah, I’m not...sure if I can...trust myself either, really...

: Because I’m...picturing it, obviously...

: Do you...want to try? Because the worst case scenario is really just me feeling gross and terrible again for a little while and then inevitably getting over it because that’s just how things are for me.

We avoid it. Almost too well.

My hand joins hers between my legs, holding my shaft steady as she tenderly runs her fingers up and down along its length, only breaking the pattern to tug it for a few seconds at time.

I’m not sure if this is her intention or just good luck but, whatever it is, I appreciate it. Just as I appreciate the mild gasps and giggles that escape her lips every twenty seconds or so.
I feel her body against mine. The heat of flesh on flesh, emphasized further by the steam of the bath, yet struck down by the wind that ultimately carries it to us.
I can’t help but want to make her sick again. And wish so desperately that she would wish for me. But I think, in a sense, she already does.
And it’s this difference in what we wish for that, again, makes everything so hard.

Yet, it still feels like I’ve done something wrong.
And I still keep thinking about the box I might be in somewhere.
